caption: Analytic cost of verifying one answer of S = 800 tokens as a function of K, from measured constants only: prefill and decode time per token on the M4 and the mean number of tokens each judge generates per verdict on the latency subset (mean K = 8.7). Not a measurement; the measured latencies are in Ch. 7.

Schematic with synthetic scores. (a) Distribution of P(supported) for supported and not supported sentences, with one threshold. (b) Moving the threshold from 1 to 0 traces the ROC curve; the dot is the threshold of panel (a); the area under the curve is the AUROC.
